provider-github

First-party GitHub provider for Tiinex — GitHub and GitHub-compatible source discovery, browsing, Git resolution and publication over provider-neutral Core and App contracts.

Grounding boundary:
- Start from `.topics/.workspaces/tiinex-provider-github.workspace.md` and the Workspace fresh-start Reduction under `.topics/reductions/workspace/`.
- Historical provider/refactor work is reduced; no prior Task is current. Future GitHub-provider work starts from a new explicit bounded Task with truthful Project ancestry.
- Provider code implements GitHub-specific capability; provider-neutral semantic qualification remains outside this repository.
